title: BlueStone Jewellery's Q1FY27: Profitability and Strong Revenue Growth
description: BlueStone Jewellery reported a significant 49% year-on-year increase in retail sales, reaching ₹733 crore in Q1FY27. The company successfully turned profitabl.

faq.q: What does "turning profitable" mean for a company?
faq.a: "Turning profitable" means a company has moved from a state of incurring losses to generating a net positive income during a specific period. It signifies that the company's revenues have exceeded its total expenses, making it financially sustainable.

Same-Store Sales Growth (SSSG) measures the increase in revenue generated by a company's retail stores that have been open for a specific period (usually at least a year). It indicates organic growth and the health of existing operations, excluding sales from newly opened stores.

faq.q: How do higher gold customs duties impact jewellery retailers?
faq.a: Higher gold customs duties increase the cost of raw gold for jewellery retailers. This can either lead to reduced profit margins if companies absorb the cost, or higher retail prices for consumers if the cost is passed on, potentially affecting demand.

faq.q: What is operating leverage and why is an improved EBITDA margin good?
faq.a: Operating leverage refers to how a company's operating income changes with sales volume. An improved EBITDA margin, reflecting strong operating leverage, means that as sales increase, profits grow at an even faster rate because fixed costs are spread over a larger revenue base, indicating greater efficiency.

faq.q: Where can I find official financial results of listed companies?
faq.a: Official financial results of listed companies are typically available on the stock exchange websites (like NSE or BSE in India) where they are listed, as well as on the company's own investor relations section of their website. You can also find them on the SEBI website through their disclosures.
